locator.section: Coverage Indications, Limitations, and/or Medical Necessity

rules.quote: B. For chronic kidney disease patients NOT on dialysis 1. Anemia of ESRD with a Hgb less than 10 g/dL or a Hct of less than 30% at initiation of therapy 2. Serum creatinine equal to or greater than 3, creatinine clearance less than 60 ml/min, or glomerular filtration rate (GFR) less than 60 mL/min/1.73 m2
